login.email: The email Root Logic Lab set up for you.
login.password: At least 8 characters. Ask Root Logic Lab to reset it if you forgot.
product.name: What customers see. Keep it short and clear.
product.slug: The web address of this product. Made from the name automatically.
product.description: Describe material, size and care. Bold, lists and links are allowed.
product.price: Selling price customers pay, in taka.
product.compareAt: Optional old price. Shown crossed out to show a discount. Must be higher than the price.
product.cost: Only you see this. Used to calculate profit on the dashboard.
product.stock: How many you have now. Stock goes down when you confirm an order.
product.sku: Your own product code, if you use one.
product.category: Where this product appears on the store.
product.status: Draft is hidden. Active is visible on the store. Archived is kept but hidden.
product.lowStock: Show a low-stock alert when stock is at or below this number.
product.seoTitle: Title on Google. Up to 70 characters.
product.seoDescription: Short summary on Google. Up to 170 characters.
category.name: Shown in the store menu, e.g. “Rice” or “Gift Sets”.
category.parent: Leave empty for a main category, or choose one to make this a sub-category.
stock.delta: Use a positive number to add (e.g. 20) or negative to remove (e.g. -2).
stock.reason: Why the stock changed — saved in the history.
user.name: Their name as your team knows it.
user.email: They sign in with this email.
user.password: Share it privately; at least 8 characters.
user.role: Owner can change settings and users; staff cannot.
seo.template: %s is replaced by the page name, e.g. “Mug | Dokan”.
seo.description: Short summary shown on Google. Up to 170 characters.
seo.ga4: GA4 → Admin → Data streams → your site → Measurement ID (starts with G-).
messages.otp: When on, customers confirm their phone with a code before the order is placed.
messages.email: Your email provider's SMTP details (Gmail, Zoho, your host). Use an app password, not your login password.
messages.sms: Paste your BD SMS gateway's send URL with {{to}}, {{text}}, {{sender}} and {{apiKey}} where its values go. Your gateway's docs show the URL.
messages.whatsapp: From Meta Business → WhatsApp → API setup. WhatsApp only delivers free-form text within 24 h of the customer's last message.
messages.owner: New orders are sent here on every channel that is on.
messages.templates: Edit what customers receive. Keep SMS short — about 70 Bangla or 160 English characters per SMS.
promotions.embed: YouTube: Share → Copy link. Facebook: open the video → ⋯ → Copy link. Instagram: open the reel/post → ⋯ → Copy link. Nothing loads from these sites until a visitor taps play.
promotions.products: Uses each product's first photo, your message and a button to the product.
promotions.poster: A simple poster: colour or image background, a headline and a button.
texts.banglaDigits: Prices and counts in the shop use ০১২৩ instead of 0123.
texts.wording: Each row is one label in the shop. The grey text is the current default; type to replace it. You may type Bangla in the English column too.
texts.language: The language a shopper sees first. Your own product text, FAQs and pages show exactly as you typed them — in Bangla or English — whichever language is picked.
pages.title: Shown at the top of the page and in the footer link.
pages.slug: Small letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. return-policy. The page opens at /page/return-policy.
pages.body: Write in English or Bangla. Start a line with ## for a heading, - for a list item; wrap words in **two stars** to make them bold. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
store.whatsapp: The number shoppers can WhatsApp. Local numbers like 01711… are fine.
store.messenger: The part after facebook.com/ for your page, e.g. ankito.bd
store.address: Printed on invoices and the contact page.
store.mapUrl: Open your shop in Google Maps → Share → Copy link.
announce: Short lines above your shop's header — offers, delivery news. Leave the messages empty to hide the bar. Links can be a page of your shop (/c/…) or a full https:// address.
